findings.scope: storefront (pre-existing, not part of the /ms admin build)
findings.check: next/image optimizer rejects unconfigured quality values
findings.detail: The image optimizer returns HTTP 400 for quality 62 and 72. Reproduced twice, stable: GET /_next/image?url=%2Fimg%2Fgenerated%2Fdesserts.webp&w=640&q=62 -> 400, q=72 -> 400, q=70 -> 200, q=75 -> 200. next.config.ts sets images.formats/deviceSizes/imageSizes but no images.qualities, so Next 16 only permits its default set. Affected source: src/components/hero-banners.tsx:52 (quality={index === 0 ? 72 : 62}) and src/app/(site)/page.tsx:138 (quality={62}). src/components/menu-item-card.tsx:39 uses 70 and is fine. Effect: hero banner images and the home category tiles serve 400 instead of an optimized image. Fix would be adding qualities: [62, 70, 72, 75] to next.config.ts images, or changing the quality props to an allowed value. Does NOT affect any /ms route and does not gate this verdict.

findings.scope: test-harness state pollution, not a code defect
findings.detail: On the FIRST harness run the gate did not fire: GET /ms with a valid session returned 200 instead of 307 -> /ms/password while admin_users.must_change_password was still 1. That run started against polluted state: the DB already held 1 leftover session row from an earlier step, and the dev server had just been force-killed and restarted over the same .next directory. After resetting the DB to its seeded state and restarting the dev server cleanly, the gate fired correctly on three independent runs (307 -> /ms/password for /ms and for every other dashboard route). Treated as stale-state/stale-.next contamination rather than a product bug, but recorded here for transparency.
